cause.statement: _market_event_time gave a row without a stated publish time the label event time (06:30Z default, 08:30Z tw_institutional_flow) and bounded it by the fetch time only for tw_price_daily. An index/breadth/flow row fetched on its trade date before the label got event_time > available_time; validate_external_source_record raised and failed the whole run.
cause.reproduction: on the pre-change code 26 of the new tests fail (11 pass: assertions that do not depend on the change)

default_label_0630Z: any other market dataset with trade_date and no published_at (e.g. tw_margin_short_balance), via the same generic path
not_label_datasets: tw_trading_holidays / tw_trading_suspension (stated publish time, own branch)
label_datasets.official_page_before_after_close: No recorded fixture shows the page content for the current trade date before versus after 13:30 Taipei (fixtures twse_mi_index_20261110.json, twse_t86_20261110.json, twse_mi_5mins_hist_201201.json are post-close captures). Not stated from memory; the rule therefore treats any row fetched before the session close as not final.

rule: label later than fetch, fetch on trade date (Taipei) and >= 05:30Z: event_time = fetched_at, available_time = fetched_at. Event never after available, never before the session close. Fetch before the close, or on a day other than the trade date, with label after fetch: that item is rejected with reason market_row_not_final; remaining items are ingested. Rejections are reported in observed.rejected_items (item id, trade date, fetched_at, detail with event label and fetch time) with observed.rejected_item_count.
residual_findings: A rejected item is not retried from the same bundle: its bundle cursor advances, so the row returns only if the collector fetches it again after the close.
A stated published_at off the trade date still raises SourceEvidenceError for the whole run (unchanged, out of scope).
